cmd:
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN= /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | head -1 | cut -d= -f2)
D=/opt/trading-bot/classic
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do cp $D/$f.py $D/$f.py.bak_before_period; curl -sfH "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f.py" -o $D/$f.py; done
chown -R tbot:tbot $D
for f in classic_strategy classic_pos_html classic_panel; do /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $D/$f.py && echo COMPILED $f; done
cp $D/config.json /tmp/config_user_backup.json
systemctl restart classicbot; sleep 10; systemctl is-active classicbot
cat > /tmp/test_period.py <<EOF
import json, urllib.request, time
def post(u, o): return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8091"+u, json.dumps(o).encode(), {"Content-Type":"application/json"}), timeout=200))
def get(u): return json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091"+u, timeout=200))
def show(tag, j):
    T=j["trades"]; net=sum(x["net"] for x in T)
    print(tag, "сделок", len(T), "net %+.2f%%" % net, "период", j.get("period"), "первая", T[0]["t_in"] if T else None, "последняя", T[-1]["t_out"] if T else None)
base = get("/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960"); show("до теста (по часам):", base)
t0=time.time()
post("/api/config", {"config": {"period_from": "2026-03-01", "period_to": "2026-05-31"}})
j = get("/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960"); show("период 01.03–31.05 (1-й вызов %.0f с):" % (time.time()-t0), j)
t0=time.time(); j = get("/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960"); show("повтор (кэш, %.1f с):" % (time.time()-t0), j)
try: post("/api/config", {"config": {"period_from": "2026-06-01", "period_to": "2026-05-01"}})
except Exception as e: print("проверка ошибки:", e.read().decode()[:120] if hasattr(e,"read") else e)
EOF
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/test_period.py 2>&1 | tail -n 8
cp /tmp/config_user_backup.json $D/config.json; chown tbot:tbot $D/config.json
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
j=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/trades?sym=ZECUSDT&bars=960", timeout=100))
print("после восстановления конфига: сделок", len(j["trades"]), "период", j.get("period"), "tf", j["cfg"]["tf"], "стоп", j["cfg"]["stop_mode"])
EOF
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8091/ | grep -c period_from
